items.title: 'AI could never make Tenebris Somnia' — the 2D horror built on live-action and practical effects
items.excerpt: PC Gamer profiles Tenebris Somnia, a 2D retro survival horror whose live-action cutscenes and practical effects are pitched as exactly the kind of craft 'AI could never make.'

items.title: Ship of Harkinian team admits years of AI use, fans call it vibecoded slop
items.excerpt: When asked what version of Ship of Harkinian doesn't contain LLM content, a dev said 'I don't know'

items.title: PS5 Linux dev quits as AI 'slop kiddies' flood open-source modding
items.excerpt: The lead developer of the PS5 Linux project quit, blaming an influx of 'AI slop kiddies' — newcomers who ship LLM-generated hacks they don't understand — for degrading open-source console modding ahead of GTA 6.

items.title: Dev vibe codes a VR tool that throws models straight at his 3D printer
items.excerpt: A developer vibe-coded a VR tool that lets him grab a 3D model in virtual space and physically throw it at his 3D printer to start a print — a prompt-built bridge between VR interaction and fabrication.

items.title: A solo dev rebuilt late-'90s console shooter enemy AI, choosing readability over intelligence
items.excerpt: Replicant D6 spoke about the retro FPS Agent 64: Spies Never Die, detailing what he wanted to preserve from the late-'90s shooter games, how he designed the enemies and how they work, and explaining why he prefers readability over intelligence in terms of combat.

items.title: Zelda art director Takaya Imamura takes backlash for an AI prototyping test
items.excerpt: Takaya Imamura was surprised that he was 'getting slammed this hard' for sharing a prototype made with the help of AI

items.title: Twitch's new AI stream coach tool pushes creators into an AI opt-out fight
items.excerpt: Twitch is testing an AI-powered stream coach that will offer suggestions on how creators can improve their channel

items.title: Steins;Gate creators' next game is an entirely vibe-coded FPS
items.excerpt: The next game from the Steins;Gate creators at Mages is an entirely vibe-coded FPS, made with AI-generated code and assets — a mainstream Japanese studio shipping a prompt-built title.

items.title: Breaking Benjamin's singer begs fans to try his AI-assisted Fallout 4 first-person mod
items.excerpt: Breaking Benjamin singer Benjamin Burnley has begged concertgoers to try an AI-assisted first person mod he's made for Fallout 4.

items.title: After the Blood Rain AI controversy, Shift Up's lead says AI still shapes their development
items.excerpt: Fans previously criticized the studio for releasing an AI-generated music video promoting the game
